verses.1: And when Shemuel became old, he appointed his sons to rule over Israel.
verses.2: And there was a man named Yoel, who was the leader of the priests. His name was Abiya. They judged in the court of Sheba.
verses.3: And their sons did not follow in their footsteps. Instead, they went astray and committed evil deeds. They broke the laws and rules.
verses.4: And all the elders of Israel gathered together, and they went to Shema’el the Ramahite.
verses.5: And they said to him, “Look, you are old now, and your sons do not follow in your footsteps. Now, a king has come to judge us, like all the other nations.”
verses.6: And it became a disaster in the eyes of Shemuel, when they said, “Give us a king to judge us.” Then Shemuel prayed to Jehovah.
verses.7: And the LORD said to Samuel, “Listen to the voice of the people for all those who say to you, ‘Do not abandon me; I have been abandoned by the king over them.’”
verses.8: All the things that they have done, from the day I brought them out of Egypt until today. They abandoned me and served other gods instead. And so it is with you as well.
verses.9: And now, hear their voices. But let them be judged according to the judgment of the king who will rule over them.
verses.10: And Shemuel told all the words of Yahweh to the people who were asking him questions.
verses.11: And he said, “This will be the judgment of the king who will rule over you. He will take your children and put them on his chariot. They will want to go before his chariot.”
verses.12: And they shall make for him thousands of soldiers, and fifty thousand more. They shall also cut down his crops in one day, and they shall do all kinds of military work related to warfare and building chariots.
verses.13: And they shall take your daughters as wives and for prostitution, and to eat them.
verses.14: And he will take away your fields, your vineyards, and your best fruits, and give them to his servants.
verses.15: And your crops and your vineyards will be multiplied, and they will be given to Sirus and his servants.
verses.16: And he will take your servants, your wives, your choosen ones who are good, and your virgins, and use them for his own purposes.
verses.17: Your children will be ten in number, and you will become their servants.
verses.18: And you shall cry out on that day before your king, who has chosen you as rulers over you. But Jehovah will not answer you on that day.
verses.19: And the people listened to the voice of Jehovah. They said, “Surely there must be a king over us.”
verses.20: And we also became like all the other nations. Our king judged us, and he stood before us to fight our battles.
verses.21: And Shemuel heard all the words of the people, and he spoke them to Jehovah’s ears.
verses.22: And the LORD said to Shemuel, “Hear his voice, and let him reign over them.” Then Shemuel said to the people of Israel, “Go, each person to his own city.”
